scripts.wasm:all: npm run wasm && npm run wasm:workshop
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:workshop: npm run build && npm run wasm:workshop && npm run baseline:ensure && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/workshop.test.mjs
